source.citation: Skinner JJ, Yu W, Gichana EK, Baxa MC, Hinshaw JR, Freed KF, Sosnick TR. Benchmarking all-atom simulations using hydrogen exchange. PNAS 2014;111(45):15975-15980.

numbering.construct: tagless 56-residue NuG2b: 1MI0 chain A with the HHHAM expression tag trimmed and the NuG2 -> NuG2b mutations applied (see scripts/download_pdbs.py)
numbering.comment: residue numbers below are 1-based positions in reference_sequence. Protection-state columns are amide NH donors, which are fewer than the residues and may skip positions, so join them via the donor residue ids that get_protection_state.py writes to the .resid file rather than by a constant offset.
